summary: First testing pass on SimpleDice MVP. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass including provably-fair determinism (recomputed HMAC-SHA256 offline from revealed prev server seed matches roll). Frontend: home loads with purple SIMPLEDICE header, register flow works, dice roll updates LED + balance + my-bets, chat post/receive works, provably-fair panel expands and rotate reveals previous seed. All required data-testids present and wired to backend correctly.

minor.issue: Negative amount and out-of-range target return HTTP 422 (Pydantic) rather than the 400 specified in requirements. Semantics are equivalent (both client errors) but spec explicitly says 400.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /api/dice/roll validators, catch Pydantic ValidationError or use manual checks so out-of-range values return 400 (not 422) to match spec strictly.
OPTIONAL: switching coin in header resets bet-amount to that coin's min (e.g. 0.00001 BTC). Consider preserving user-entered amount unless below min.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 581 lines; if it grows further consider splitting into routers (auth, dice, bets, chat).
dice roll flow performs 2 DB writes (users update + bets insert) non-transactionally; on partial failure balance/bet may desync. Fine for demo money.
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded default 'dev-secret-change-me-in-prod-simpledice' — ensure a real JWT_SECRET is set in production .env.
roll_dice uses only first 8 hex chars mod 10000 — introduces a very tiny bias (2^32 mod 10000 = 7296). Acceptable for demo but not perfectly uniform.
Race-condition potential: concurrent /api/dice/roll for same user reads user doc then updates; two parallel rolls could reuse same nonce. Use $inc on nonce or findOneAndUpdate for atomicity.
test_credentials: None required; tests create fresh users via /api/auth/register with random emails.
seed_data_creation: Random TEST_/testroll_/testui_ prefixed users created during tests; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is pytest-based and reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend fully functional at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; use data-testids listed in review_request.
